Chirag Paswan's Party Aims for National Status, Expands Punjab Presence

Lok Janshakti Party (Ram Vilas) is undertaking efforts to secure national party status. The party is also making a strategic move in Punjab. Separately, there is a stated resolution within the party to make Chirag Paswan the Chief Minister, with the LJP-R outlining a mission for this objective in Bihar.
